title: Triage classifies every failure into exactly one class before remediation
statement: Every failure entering the framework MUST be classified into exactly one of plant-bug, sensor-error, policy-issue, or reference-gap before any discipline begins remediation, and a classification below confidence MUST be reported as inconclusive rather than forced.
rationale: Article 15 makes triage the loop entry; Article 39 forbids false precision when the classification is uncertain.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
